li.label: the lost letters got home
li.description: The letters we found by the old road got where they were going at last, years late. I like to think of them being opened at someone's kitchen table.

li.label: the stranger's garden
li.description: The stranger's seeds came up strong in our soil, the last of their kind. We've been saving the seed in a jar on the shelf.

li.label: my field is choked
li.description: The stranger's plant has taken over my field, runners and all. I should have pulled it up when I could.

li.label: saw the play about us
li.description: The troupe played our own story for us in the yard, painted flats and all. Watching strangers play us was the oddest thing, and I clapped until my hands stung.

li.label: they put us on the stage
li.description: The play about our colony is a hit in the towns along the road. People who've never set foot here know our names now.
